sentences.en: Well, this is Ghada Al-Khord from Gaza.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是来自加沙的加达·阿尔-霍尔德。

sentences.en: We are really starving.
sentences.zh: 我们真的在挨饿。

sentences.en: Honestly, there is nothing to be eaten here in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 老实说，在加沙这里什么吃的都没有。

sentences.en: I'm not eating anything.
sentences.zh: 我什么都没吃。

sentences.en: We are losing too much weight.
sentences.zh: 我们瘦得太厉害了。

sentences.en: But for me, maybe I lost more than 10 kilos now.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，现在可能瘦了10公斤以上。

sentences.en: And my bones, you can see my bones now.
sentences.zh: 我的骨头，你现在都能看到我的骨头了。

sentences.en: Soon I'll be a skeleton.
sentences.zh: 很快我就要变成一具骷髅了。

sentences.en: It's very hard.
sentences.zh: 这太艰难了。

sentences.en: I couldn't imagine in my life that I'll be in this situation, like starving in 2025.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子都无法想象自己会陷入这种境地，像在2025年忍饥挨饿。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是雷切尔·阿布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: The suffering in Gaza has reached new depths.
sentences.zh: 加沙的苦难已经达到了新的深渊。

sentences.en: And now finding food, which was already scarce, has become a deadly endeavor.
sentences.zh: 而现在，寻找原本就稀缺的食物已经变成了一项致命的努力。

sentences.en: Israeli forces have opened fire on crowds of desperate, hungry people who are trying to access aid sites established by a new and controversial humanitarian group.
sentences.zh: 以色列军队向绝望、饥饿的人群开枪，这些人正试图进入由一个崭新且备受争议的人道主义组织建立的援助点。

sentences.en: Hundreds of people have been killed, according to Gaza health officials.
sentences.zh: 据加沙卫生官员称，已有数百人丧生。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Erin Boxerman on who is behind the distribution system and why it's been so deadly.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事埃琳·博克斯曼将讲述这个分发系统背后的主使以及它为何如此致命。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, July 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月24日，星期四。

sentences.en: Aaron, welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 埃隆，欢迎回到节目中。

sentences.en: It's about 7 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我想，你在的耶路撒冷现在

sentences.en: where you are in Jerusalem, I think.
sentences.zh: 大约是晚上7点。

sentences.en: So we really appreciate you making the time for us.
sentences.zh: 所以我们非常感谢你抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Always great to be here.
sentences.zh: 能来这里总是太棒了。

sentences.en: So, Aaron, to start, the humanitarian situation in Gaza has obviously been dire since the start of the war.
sentences.zh: 那么，埃隆，首先，自战争爆发以来，加沙的人道主义局势显然一直十分严峻。

sentences.en: But in recent weeks, the situation seems to have deteriorated even further.
sentences.zh: 但在最近几周，局势似乎进一步恶化了。

sentences.en: Specifically,
sentences.zh: 具体来说，

sentences.en: we've been hearing reports about hundreds of Palestinians that have been killed by the Israeli military while trying to reach what limited aid has actually gotten into Gaza.
sentences.zh: 我们一直听到报道称，数百名巴勒斯坦人在试图获取真正进入加沙的有限援助时，被以色列军方杀害。

sentences.en: So can you explain what has been going on at these aid sites and why have these people been killed?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下这些援助点到底发生了什么，为什么这些人会被杀吗？

sentences.en: So, first of all, you're absolutely right, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 所以，首先，雷切尔，你完全说得对。

sentences.en: We've seen for many months now that for many, many Gazans, finding food and water has been an endless daily struggle.
sentences.zh: 几个月来我们一直看到，对许许多多的加沙人来说，寻找食物和水是一场无休止的每日挣扎。

sentences.en: And the situation was really exacerbated earlier this year when Israel put a blockade on basically all food, medicine, and fuel entering Gaza for nearly three months.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，以色列对几乎所有进入加沙的食品、药品和燃料实施了近三个月的封锁，局势因此真正恶化了。

sentences.en: Since then, the blockade was eased.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，封锁有所放宽。

sentences.en: Aid is going back into the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 援助物资正在重新进入加沙地带。

sentences.en: But the way that it's being distributed has been totally upended.
sentences.zh: 但它的分发方式发生了彻底的颠覆。

sentences.en: And so we're seeing a situation on the ground that we haven't really seen during the course of this nearly two-year war.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们看到了地面上的局势，这是在这场将近两年的战争中我们从未真正见过的。

sentences.en: In less than two months, hundreds of Palestinians have been killed and wounded near new aid distribution sites that are under the control of the Israeli military.
sentences.zh: 在不到两个月的时间里，在由以色列军方控制的新援助分发点附近，数百名巴勒斯坦人被杀死和打伤。

sentences.en: And Palestinians in Gaza who've spoken to us have described how, you know, just getting a box of food for themselves and their family has become a life-threatening endeavor.
sentences.zh: 与我们交谈过的加沙巴勒斯坦人描述说，你知道，仅仅为自己和家人弄到一箱食物就已经变成了一项危及生命的行动。

sentences.en: Do we know exactly how many people have died?
sentences.zh: 我们确切知道有多少人死亡吗？

sentences.en: All of these incidents are difficult to assess from the outside.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事件从外部都很难评估。

sentences.en: The Israeli military doesn't allow international journalists into Gaza so that we could report and investigate these incidents freely.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方不允许国际记者进入加沙，以便我们能够自由地报道和调查这些事件。

sentences.en: But according to Gaza health officials, over 1,000 people have been killed, more than 600 of them near these new aid distribution sites.
sentences.zh: 但据加沙卫生官员称，已有1000多人丧生，其中600多人是在这些新的援助分发点附近。

sentences.en: Israeli officials have broadly disputed those figures.
sentences.zh: 以色列官员大体上对这些数字提出了异议。

sentences.en: They've suggested that they're exaggerated, but they also haven't provided any alternative death toll.
sentences.zh: 他们暗示这些数字被夸大了，但他们也没有提供任何替代的死亡人数统计。

sentences.en: So this new aid system, what about it is resulting in all of these deaths?
sentences.zh: 那么这个新的援助系统，究竟是其中的什么导致了所有这些死亡？

sentences.en: So there's a number of factors.
sentences.zh: 所以有许多因素。

sentences.en: And if we want to understand the sort of new aid system, we have to understand what it replaced.
sentences.zh: 如果我们想理解这种新的援助系统，我们就必须理解它取代了什么。

sentences.en: So much of the international aid that was entering the Gaza Strip, that was reaching its 2 million people, was going through a system coordinated by the United Nations,
sentences.zh: 进入加沙地带的大部分国际援助，即惠及那200万人的援助，都是通过一个由联合国协调的系统进行的，

sentences.en: which ran or coordinated a big network of hundreds of sites across the Gaza Strip where aid would be distributed to Gazans more or less where they were.
sentences.zh: 联合国运营或协调了加沙地带数百个站点的庞大网络，这些站点会在加沙人所在的地方或多或少地向他们分发援助。

sentences.en: And Israel had long been critical of that system.
sentences.zh: 以色列长期以来一直批评该系统。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Israeli officials said that Hamas was profiting off the existing system.
sentences.zh: 以色列官员表示，哈马斯正在从现有系统中牟利，

sentences.en: either by diverting aid or by selling aid.
sentences.zh: 或者是通过转移援助物资，或者是通过出售援助物资。

sentences.en: And they essentially said that as the current aid system was set up, they were essentially providing a lifeline to Hamas, that these hundreds of trucks of aid that were going in
sentences.zh: 他们本质上说，由于目前的援助系统是这样建立的，他们实际上是在给哈马斯提供一条生命线，这数百辆开进去的援助卡车

sentences.en: were undermining Israel's ability to topple the Palestinian armed group that had launched the deadliest attack on its civilians in Israeli history on October 7th,
sentences.zh: 正在削弱以色列推翻巴勒斯坦武装派别的能力，该派别曾在10月7日发动了以色列历史上针对平民的最致命袭击，

sentences.en: the attack that triggered the war.
sentences.zh: 即引发这场战争的袭击。

sentences.en: Is that credible, the idea that Hamas was basically seizing on this food, this aid that was coming in?
sentences.zh: 这种说法可信吗，即哈马斯基本上在抢夺这些食物、这些送进来的援助？

sentences.en: As far as we know, there have been incidents where, for example, gunmen have hijacked aid convoys, where they've stolen bags of flour from aid trucks.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，确实发生过这样的事件：例如，枪手劫持了援助车队，从援助卡车上偷走了几袋面粉。

sentences.en: But it's really hard to tell whether this is Hamas or other gangs.
sentences.zh: 但这很难分清到底是哈马斯还是其他帮派干的。

sentences.en: And then there's the bigger question of whether this is systemic, if it's happening on a large scale.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一个更大的问题，即这是否具有系统性，是否在大规模发生。

sentences.en: The United Nations says that they haven't seen a lot of evidence of that.
sentences.zh: 联合国表示，他们没有看到很多这方面的证据。

sentences.en: And Israel as well hasn't presented a lot of evidence publicly to back up that claim.
sentences.zh: 以色列同样也没有公开大量证据来支持这种说法。

sentences.en: And another reason that Israel was, you know, sort of frustrated and skeptical with the old UN dominated system was longstanding tensions between Israel and the UN.
sentences.zh: 以色列对由联合国主导的旧系统感到沮丧和怀疑的另一个原因是，以色列和联合国之间存在长期紧张关系。

sentences.en: Many Israeli leaders have called the United Nations biased.
sentences.zh: 许多以色列领导人称联合国带有偏见。

sentences.en: And there's a fundamental mistrust between Israel and the United Nations about the humanitarian situation as a whole.
sentences.zh: 对于整体人道主义局势，以色列和联合国之间存在根本的不信任。

sentences.en: Israel has consistently said that the UN is exaggerating or is not correct or saying that it's worse than it is, right?
sentences.zh: 以色列一直表示联合国夸大了情况，或者不准确，或者说情况没有那么糟，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Israel has frequently said that UN officials are distorting the reality on the ground.
sentences.zh: 以色列经常表示，联合国官员歪曲了地面现实。

sentences.en: At various points, Israeli officials also said that there was no wide-scale humanitarian crisis in
sentences.zh: 在不同的时间点，以色列官员还表示加沙没有发生大规模的人道主义危机，

sentences.en: Gaza, even as UN officials and aid workers on the ground were describing a very different picture.
sentences.zh: 尽管地面的联合国官员和救援人员描述的画面完全不同。

sentences.en: And so many of our listeners have probably seen videos of people in need of food in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的许多听众可能都看过加沙需要食物的人们的视频。

sentences.en: You know, videos that show crowds of hungry Gazans trying to get aid.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那些展示成群结队的饥饿加沙人试图获取援助的视频。

sentences.en: But Israel and the UN have been at odds really throughout much of the war about the nature and the depth of the crisis in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，在战争的大部分时间里，以色列和联合国一直在加沙危机的性质和深度问题上存在分歧。

sentences.en: So we see that there are these longstanding tensions between Israel and the
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到，以色列和

sentences.en: United Nations.
sentences.zh: 联合国之间存在这些长期的紧张关系。

sentences.en: And Israel basically wanted to make a new aid distribution system in a way that officially was described as neutral and independent.
sentences.zh: 以色列基本上希望建立一个新的援助分发系统，在官方被描述为中立和独立的方式下进行。

sentences.en: So talk about that new system.
sentences.zh: 那么谈谈那个新系统吧。

sentences.en: Describe it for us.
sentences.zh: 为我们描述一下。

sentences.en: So earlier this year, in the spring, we started hearing about how Israel was starting to brief the aid community.
sentences.zh: 所以在今年早些时候的春天，我们开始听到以色列开始向援助界进行吹风。

sentences.en: They were starting to brief UN workers and tell them there's going to be a huge overhaul in terms of how aid is done in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他们开始向联合国工作人员通报情况，并告诉他们，加沙的援助工作方式将进行重大彻底改革。

sentences.en: And then about a month later, we started to understand that there was a separate group that
sentences.zh: 然后大约一个月后，我们开始了解到，有一个独立的群体

sentences.en: was going to be involved that circumvented the United Nations and that really circumvented every existing aid organization that we were aware of.
sentences.zh: 将参与进来，它绕过了联合国，并且真正绕过了我们所知的每一个现有的援助组织。

sentences.en: It was going to be carried out by a totally new organization, which had been established seemingly for this purpose called the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation.
sentences.zh: 它将由一个完全崭新的组织执行，这个组织似乎就是为此目的而成立的，名叫加沙人道主义基金会。

sentences.en: But who was behind this organization?
sentences.zh: 但这个组织背后是谁？

sentences.en: How was this organization formed?
sentences.zh: 这个组织是如何成立的？

sentences.en: All of that was murky.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都很模糊。

sentences.en: There were not a lot of public details about who and what and how this organization was going to function.
sentences.zh: 关于这个组织是谁、是什么以及将如何运作，并没有太多的公开细节。

sentences.en: And so my colleagues and I,
sentences.zh: 因此，我的同事和我，

sentences.en: Patrick Kingsley,
sentences.zh: 帕特里克·金斯利，

sentences.en: Natan Odenheimer, and Renan Bergman, began looking into it.
sentences.zh: 内坦·奥登海默和雷南·伯格曼开始对此进行调查。

sentences.en: So what did you all find?
sentences.zh: 那么你们都发现了什么？

sentences.en: So what my colleagues found was that even though the project was billed as neutral and independent, it was actually an Israeli creation.
sentences.zh: 我的同事们发现，尽管该项目被标榜为中立和独立，但它实际上是以色列的产物。

sentences.en: As far back as the earliest weeks of the war, a whole host of people, businessmen, tech people, military
sentences.zh: 早在战争的最早几周，形形色色的人——商人、科技界人士、军方官员——

sentences.en: officials, they all started meeting and they came up with this plan that would basically replace the aid system in Gaza as we knew it to that point.
sentences.zh: 都开始开会，他们想出了这个计划，基本上将取代我们到那时为止所知的加沙援助系统。

sentences.en: And all throughout 2024, they lobbied for the idea, they met with Israeli leaders, and they really built up a coalition of support for the project.
sentences.zh: 在整个2024年，他们一直在为这个想法进行游说，与以色列领导人会面，并真正为该项目建立了一个支持联盟。

sentences.en: Essentially, the idea that they had was that private contractors would distribute aid in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 本质上，他们的想法是让私人承包商在加沙分发援助。

sentences.en: These would be in areas that were controlled by the Israeli military, where Israel would sort of be overseeing what was going on, even though Israel would not be responsible for
sentences.zh: 这些将是在以色列军方控制的地区，以色列将在那里监督正在发生的事情，尽管以色列将不负责

sentences.en: handing out the aid.
sentences.zh: 分发援助物资。

sentences.en: And that would circumvent what Israeli officials saw as a problematic
sentences.zh: 这将绕过以色列官员视为有问题的

sentences.en: United Nations system and enable Israel to exert more control over the flow of aid.
sentences.zh: 联合国系统，并使以色列能够对援助流向施加更多控制。

sentences.en: And eventually, they decided that those private companies would be American once.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们决定这些私营公司将是美国公司。

sentences.en: American companies?
sentences.zh: 美国公司？

sentences.en: Why American?
sentences.zh: 为什么是美国公司？

sentences.en: Well, it appears Israel didn't want this to be a project that had an Israeli face.
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然以色列不希望这是一个带有以色列面孔的项目。

sentences.en: So they looked abroad for help.
sentences.zh: 所以他们向海外寻求帮助。

sentences.en: The people behind the idea tried to bring on board respected humanitarians who would really provide legitimacy to the project.
sentences.zh: 该想法背后的推动者试图拉拢受人尊敬的人道主义人士，为该项目提供真正的合法性。

sentences.en: The Israeli government even reached out to the UN to see if they would work under these new conditions.
sentences.zh: 以色列政府甚至联系了联合国，看他们是否愿意在这些新条件下工作。

sentences.en: But they, as well as much of the international aid community, really wanted nothing to do with this.
sentences.zh: 但他们以及大部分国际援助界真的不想与此有任何瓜葛。

sentences.en: They said that working so closely with Israel would compromise their independence, and they were really worried that the combination
sentences.zh: 他们表示，与以色列合作得如此紧密会损害他们的独立性，他们真的很担心以色列士兵与渴望援助的巴勒斯坦人群体的结合

sentences.en: of Israeli soldiers and crowds of Palestinians desperate for aid would lead to violence.
sentences.zh: 会导致暴力。

sentences.en: And so many of the people whose names were floated to potentially help with the project, including a former head of the World Food Program, said no.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多被列为潜在帮助该项目的人选，包括世界粮食计划署前负责人，都拒绝了。

sentences.en: But one of the people they did manage to get was someone named Jake Wood, who's a former U.S.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实成功拉拢到的其中一个人名叫杰克·伍德，他是一名美国前海军陆战队员。

sentences.en: Marine.
sentences.zh: 陆战队员。

sentences.en: He becomes the executive director of the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation, which is set up as a nonprofit in the United States,
sentences.zh: 他成为了加沙人道主义基金会的执行董事，该基金会在美国注册为非营利组织，

sentences.en: and which basically serves as the public face of the group and it raises funding to fund the group's operations.
sentences.zh: 基本上充当该集团的公众门面，并为其筹集资金以资助该集团的运营。

sentences.en: And it's not really clear who is actually providing much of the funding to this group.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚究竟是谁在为该组织提供大部分资金。

sentences.en: We know that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们知道美国

sentences.en: government has said publicly that they provided $30 million.
sentences.zh: 政府曾公开表示他们提供了3000万美元。

sentences.en: The foundation has said that they've received more than $100 million from an unnamed European country.
sentences.zh: 该基金会表示，他们已经从一个未具名的欧洲国家获得了超过1亿美元的资金。

sentences.en: But a lot about the group's finances, a lot about how this group has been operating is still very murky and has not been disclosed to the public.
sentences.zh: 但该集团的财务状况以及该集团如何运作的许多细节仍然非常模糊，尚未向公众披露。

sentences.en: Do we have any sense about whether Israel is providing any funding for it?
sentences.zh: 我们是否感觉到以色列是否在为其提供任何资金？

sentences.en: That's another big mystery.
sentences.zh: 那是另一个巨大的谜团。

sentences.en: There's been a lot of speculation about it.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点有很多猜测。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, we really don't know for sure whether Israel has provided financial backing.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我们确实不知道以色列是否提供了财政支持。

sentences.en: We know that they support it, that they've advocated for it.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他们支持它，他们为之进行了辩护。

sentences.en: But in terms of financial backing, we just don't know for sure yet.
sentences.zh: 但在财政支持方面，我们目前还无法确定。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: So the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation, that's the public-facing element.
sentences.zh: 所以加沙人道主义基金会是面向公众的元素。

sentences.en: But there's also the people that are really carrying this out on the ground.
sentences.zh: 但还有那些真正在地面上执行这一任务的人。

sentences.en: That's a different company.
sentences.zh: 那是另一家公司。

sentences.en: It's called Safe Reach Solutions, and it's run by Phil Riley, who's an ex-CIA officer.
sentences.zh: 它叫安全通达解决方案公司，由前中情局官员菲尔·赖利运营。

sentences.en: And under this system, Riley and the contractors who work for him are basically going to be the ones who are overseeing security at the aid sites themselves.
sentences.zh: 在该系统下，赖利和为他工作的承包商基本上将负责监督援助点本身的安保工作。

sentences.en: And what would that look like?
sentences.zh: 那会是什么样子的？

sentences.en: So really, the idea was that there would be four sites, at least to start, and they would be in southern and central Gaza.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，我们的想法是至少先设立四个站点，它们将位于加沙南部和中部。

sentences.en: And that's a huge reduction.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的缩减。

sentences.en: Remember, the UN had about 400 distribution sites across the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 记住，联合国在加沙地带大约有400个分发点。

sentences.en: These four new sites would be in areas that are under Israeli military control.
sentences.zh: 这四个新站点将位于以色列军方控制的地区。

sentences.en: So Palestinians, if they wanted to get aid from the sites, would have to walk through areas with armed Israeli soldiers.
sentences.zh: 因此，巴勒斯坦人如果想从这些站点获得援助，就必须穿过有武装以色列士兵驻守的地区。

sentences.en: And only after that, they would arrive at these aid sites, which were run by American contractors.
sentences.zh: 直到那之后，他们才会到达这些由美国承包商运营的援助点。

sentences.en: And again, that was really one of the biggest issues for the humanitarian community.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，这确实是人道主义社群面临的最大问题之一。

sentences.en: What specifically was the complaint or the concern?
sentences.zh: 具体的投诉或担忧是什么？

sentences.en: Well, they thought it was going to be really dangerous, basically.
sentences.zh: 嗯，基本上他们认为这会非常危险。

sentences.en: I mean, they thought that Gazans would have to walk really long distances to get to these places,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们认为加沙人必须步行很长的距离才能到达这些地方，

sentences.en: that there was going to be huge amounts of crowding as desperate people tried to get to a small number of sites.
sentences.zh: 当绝望的人们试图涌入少数几个地点时，将会出现极其严重的拥挤。

sentences.en: And they were really worried about the potential for Israeli soldiers or contractors to use force to control these large crowds of people arriving.
sentences.zh: 他们非常担心以色列士兵或承包商可能会使用武力来控制这些大量涌入的人群。

sentences.en: And another concern that the United Nations and other people raised about this was that
sentences.zh: 联合国和其他人对此提出的另一个担忧是，

sentences.en: Israeli leaders at the time were already suggesting that they wanted to move a huge number of Palestinians in Gaza from the north to the south.
sentences.zh: 当时的以色列领导人已经表示，他们希望将加沙的大量巴勒斯坦人从北部迁移到南部。

sentences.en: And they worried that this whole idea of creating a new aid system was actually just a strategy for forcibly displacing huge numbers of Palestinians by ensuring that the only
sentences.zh: 他们担心，这种创建新援助体系的想法实际上只是一种策略，通过确保唯一能获得援助的地方

sentences.en: place where they could get aid was going to be in this very small area of southern Gaza.
sentences.zh: 只能在加沙南部这个极小的区域内，来达到强行流离失所大量巴勒斯坦人的目的。

sentences.en: And so they saw this as not really an aid system, but as a military strategy, as a way for the
sentences.zh: 因此，他们认为这根本不是一个援助体系，而是一种军事策略，是以军通过本质上将食物作为把人们留

sentences.en: Israeli military to sort of conveniently hem off a large number of people in a small area by using food, essentially, as a way to keep people in a small part of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 在加沙小片区域内的手段，来顺便将大量人口封锁在一个狭小区域内的方法。

sentences.en: And so there's been all this criticism before the gaza humanitarian foundation even opens its doors at the end of may and just
sentences.zh: 因此，甚至在加沙人道主义基金会于5月底开门之前，就充满了各种批评，就在它准备首次开始分发援助的

sentences.en: hours before it's set to start distributing aid for the first time when jake wood the organization's
sentences.zh: 几个小时前，该组织的公开代言人、此前一直为其辩护的杰克·伍德（Jake Wood）

sentences.en: public face who defended it then resigns suddenly in the middle of the night he puts out a statement
sentences.zh: 在半夜突然辞职，他发表了一份声明

sentences.en: which says it is clear that it is not possible to implement this plan while also strictly adhering to the humanitarian principles of humanity,
sentences.zh: 其中写道：显然，在无法严格遵守人道、中立、公正和独立这些人道主义原则的情况下，是不可能执行这一计划的，

sentences.en: neutrality, impartiality, and independence, which I will not abandon.
sentences.zh: 而我是不会放弃这些原则的。

sentences.en: He essentially repeats many of the criticisms which the United Nations and which other people had made of the foundation.
sentences.zh: 他基本上重复了联合国和其他人对该基金会提出的许多批评。

sentences.en: And this is really another blow to the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation, which was set to open its first site for aid distribution just hours later.
sentences.zh: 这对加沙人道主义基金会来说无疑是又一次打击，而就在几小时后，该基金会本应开放其第一个援助分发点。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin, And I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰（Benjamin Poulin），我是马克·朗森（Mark Ronson），欢迎收听《重构者》（The Reframers），这是一个专注于热爱设计及周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs, in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 即使在当年我在夜店打碟的黑胶唱片时代，你每天晚上也要带着 300 件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个像是由美丽的 50 年代文物组成的活生生的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在可以在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼（Audemars Piguet）的《重构者》。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘（Wynna Liu）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写“连线”（Connections）游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天都创作“拼写蜜蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“字母箱”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉（promesthesia）的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到声音的人这样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com slash games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So Aaron, before the break, you talked about how this new aid distribution system launched, despite what sounds like a lot of criticism from many different quarters.
sentences.zh: 那么，亚伦，在休息之前，你谈到了这个新的援助分发系统是如何启动的，尽管来自许多不同方面的批评声听起来很大。

sentences.en: Talk to us about the early days.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲早期的情况吧。

sentences.en: How did the launch go?
sentences.zh: 启动情况怎么样？

sentences.en: So it started in late May,
sentences.zh: 所以它在五月下旬开始，

sentences.en: and it's been difficult to really get a sense of what's going on because Israel doesn't allow us to freely move around in Gaza and visit and see the sites for ourselves in an independent way.
sentences.zh: 要真正了解发生了什么一直很困难，因为以色列不允许我们在加沙自由移动、以独立的方式去参观和亲自查看这些地点。

sentences.en: And so my colleagues and I managed to speak to several people who tried to get aid from those sites during those first few extremely chaotic days.
sentences.zh: 因此，我和我的同事设法采访了几个人，他们在头几天极其混乱的日子里试图从这些地点获取援助。

sentences.en: So I got on the phone with a man named Mohamed Sagar.
sentences.zh: 所以我给一个名叫穆罕默德·萨加尔（Mohamed Sagar）的男子打了电话。

sentences.en: He's 43 years old.
sentences.zh: 他今年 43 岁。

sentences.en: He lives in a half-destroyed apartment in the southern Gaza city of Khan Yunus with his three kids and his mom.
sentences.zh: 他和三个孩子以及母亲住在加沙南部城市汗尤尼斯（Khan Yunus）一间半毁的公寓里。

sentences.en: And he went to one of the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation sites on June 1St.
sentences.zh: 他在 6 月 1 日去了加沙人道主义基金会的其中一个地点。

sentences.en: So that was just a few days after it opened.
sentences.zh: 所以那正好是在它开业几天后。

sentences.en: He told me that he learned that the site was going to be open at 5 a.m.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他在早上 5 点得知该地点将要开放，

sentences.en: And he wanted to get there as early as possible so that he'd be at the front of the line.
sentences.zh: 他想尽可能早地赶到那里，以便能排在队伍的最前面。

sentences.en: And so Mohammed told me that he left his house in the middle of the night and began walking to the distribution site, which is several kilometers away from his house in Kanyunas.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德告诉我，他在半夜离开家，开始步行前往分发点，该分发点距离他在汗尤尼斯的家有几公里远。

sentences.en: He arrived in the area at about 3 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 他在凌晨 3 点左右到达了该地区。

sentences.en: It was still dark,
sentences.zh: 天还是黑的，

sentences.en: and he waited along with other people near the distribution site, inside the perimeter, controlled by the Israeli military.
sentences.zh: 他和其他人一起在分发点附近等待，在以色列军方控制的警戒线内。

sentences.en: Everybody was pushing, you know, pushing.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在推搡，你知道的，都在推搡。

sentences.en: They're trying to get forward.
sentences.zh: 他们试图往前挤。

sentences.en: A lot of Gazans, including Mohammed, were worried that if they weren't at the front of the line,
sentences.zh: 许多加沙人，包括穆罕默德在内，都担心如果他们不在队伍的最前面，

sentences.en: there wouldn't be any food left, and they would have walked for hours in the dark, basically for nothing.
sentences.zh: 就会没有食物剩下，他们白白在黑暗中走了几个小时，基本上是徒劳无功。

sentences.en: And then he said, there was an announcement from a drone, basically telling people to get back.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，无人机发出了广播，基本上是叫大家退后。

sentences.en: But there were so many people, and basically nobody could move back.
sentences.zh: 但人实在太多了，基本上没有人能退后。

sentences.en: And then, he said he started hearing what he described as warning shots, but the crowd was still pressing forward.
sentences.zh: 接着，他说他开始听到他所说的警告射击，但人群仍在向前推挤。

sentences.en: And that's when, according to Muhammad, people started getting shot, and everybody dropped to the ground out of fear.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，据穆罕默德所说，人们开始遭到枪击，所有人都出于恐惧扑倒在地上。

sentences.en: and he says there was an old woman next to him who got shot in the leg
sentences.zh: 他说他旁边有一个老妇人腿部中枪了

sentences.en: he remembers someone yelling my grandma, my grandma but he says there was basically nothing they could do people were just too scared to move so no one could help them
sentences.zh: 他记得有人在大喊“我的奶奶，我的奶奶”，但他说他们基本上无能为力，大家实在太害怕而无法动弹，所以没有人能帮他们

sentences.en: and later the sun came up it started to grow light out
sentences.zh: 后来太阳升起了，天开始亮了

sentences.en: he said he could see bodies from people who had been shot and despite all of this
sentences.zh: 他说他能看到中枪身亡者的尸体，尽管发生了这一切

sentences.en: Mohammed actually goes to the site
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德还是去了那个地点

sentences.en: he says that he ran as fast as he could he grabbed one of the boxes that was on the floor and he tried to run away as quickly as possible
sentences.zh: 他说他以最快的速度奔跑，抓起地上的一個箱子，并试图尽可能快地跑开

sentences.en: because he was scared that after all of that that somebody might attack him on the way back and steal the food that he fought so hard to get
sentences.zh: 因为他害怕经历这一切之后，会有人在回程的路上袭击他，抢走他历经千辛万苦才弄到的食物

sentences.en: And he said the situation at the aid site was a kind of race for food.
sentences.zh: 他说援助点的局势简直是一场争夺食物的竞赛。

sentences.en: It was almost like, you know, everybody's sort of out for themselves, you know, everybody racing each other to try to get a box of food.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像是，你知道的，每个人都在为自己打算，你知道的，每个人都在互相竞速以试图得到一箱食物。

sentences.en: That's the level of chaos and desperation that Muhammad said he saw.
sentences.zh: 这就是穆罕默德所说的他所看到的混乱和绝望的程度。

sentences.en: that is just a horrific story what details from it have you been able to confirm and
sentences.zh: 这真是一个可怕的故事，其中的哪些细节是你能够证实并且

sentences.en: what do we know about how many people died that day it's absolutely a horrific story
sentences.zh: 我们对那天有多少人死亡了解多少？这绝对是一个可怕的故事

sentences.en: and when we heard stories both muhammad's and stories like it we try to verify and confirm
sentences.zh: 当我们听到穆罕默德的故事和类似的故事时，我们会尽可能地去核实和证实

sentences.en: them as much as possible which is often difficult to do in gaza but here's what we do know we know
sentences.zh: 它们，这在加沙通常很难做到，但这是我们目前所知道的：我们知道

sentences.en: that on that morning, early on June 1st, the Red Cross, which has a field hospital in Rafah nearby, had a mass casualty influx shortly after the shooting near the aid site began.
sentences.zh: 在6月1日那天早晨，红十字会在附近拉法（Rafah）设有野战医院，在援助点附近的枪击事件开始后不久，便迎来了大批伤员涌入。

sentences.en: More than 170 people arrived.
sentences.zh: 有 170 多人到达。

sentences.en: Most of them had gunshot wounds or shrapnel wounds.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数有枪伤或弹片伤。

sentences.en: 21 of them were declared dead upon arrival.
sentences.zh: 其中 21 人被宣告到达时死亡。

sentences.en: And the patients who survived, the wounded, said that they'd been trying to reach an aid distribution site.
sentences.zh: 幸存的伤者表示，他们当时正试图前往一个援助分发点。

sentences.en: So the Red Cross in its statement doesn't say who shot them.
sentences.zh: 因此，红十字会在其声明中并未说明是谁开枪打的他们。

sentences.en: But Mohammed and other Palestinians who we spoke to who were there that day said that it was
sentences.zh: 但穆罕默德以及我们采访过的当天在场的其他巴勒斯坦人表示，是

sentences.en: Israeli soldiers.
sentences.zh: 以色列士兵。

sentences.en: Now, this was an extremely contested incident.
sentences.zh: 现在，这是一起争议极大的事件。

sentences.en: The Israeli military denied shooting civilians near or at the aid site.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方否认在援助点附近或内部向平民开枪。

sentences.en: But an Israeli military official later briefed reporters and told them that Israeli troops had fired what the official described as warning shots
sentences.zh: 但一名以色列军方官员随后向记者进行了闭门通报，并告诉他们，以色列军队曾开枪发射了该官员所说的警告射击

sentences.en: at, quote, several suspects as the crowds of Palestinians had approached them during a period when the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation's site wasn't open yet.
sentences.zh: 目标是“几名嫌疑人”，当时加沙人道主义基金会的地点尚未开放，而巴勒斯坦人的人群正向他们逼近。

sentences.en: Okay, so that's what the Israeli military said.
sentences.zh: 好的，这就是以色列军方的说法。

sentences.en: What about the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation?
sentences.zh: 那么加沙人道主义基金会呢？

sentences.en: What did they say?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么说的？

sentences.en: The Gaza Humanitarian Foundation said that it was unaware of any attacks in or around its site and that all the aid was distributed between 5 a.m.
sentences.zh: 加沙人道主义基金会表示，它不知道其地点内部或周围发生过任何袭击，并且所有援助物资均在上午 5 点

sentences.en: and 6 a.m., which is when the site was open.
sentences.zh: 至上午 6 点之间分发完毕，当时该地点处于开放状态。

sentences.en: But according to Palestinian witnesses and the Israeli military official who spoke to reporters, the incident seemed to have been about a kilometer away from the site.
sentences.zh: 但根据巴勒斯坦目击者和接受记者采访的以色列军方官员的说法，这起事件似乎发生在距离该地点约一公里远的地方。

sentences.en: Today, there was another deadly shooting involving civilians at a food distribution center in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 今天，加沙的一处粮食分发中心再次发生了一起涉及平民的致命枪击事件。

sentences.en: We've seen similar episodes recur.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到类似事件不断重演。

sentences.en: Palestinian health officials say four people were killed this morning at a food distribution center in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦卫生官员称，今天上午加沙的一处粮食分发中心有四人丧生。

sentences.en: Again.
sentences.zh: 又发生了。

sentences.en: Medics and at least 38 Palestinians were killed today in new shootings near food distribution centers in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 医务人员称，今天加沙粮食分发中心附近发生的新枪击事件导致至少 38 名巴勒斯坦人丧生。

sentences.en: And again.
sentences.zh: 又发生了。

sentences.en: At least 49 people have been killed while waiting for aid trucks across Gaza over just 24 hours, according to Palestinian health officials.
sentences.zh: 据巴勒斯坦卫生官员称，在短短 24 小时内，加沙各地至少已有 49 人在等待救援卡车时丧生。

sentences.en: We've seen incidents where crowds of Palestinians seeking aid from these sites in southern Gaza have repeatedly come under fire.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到，在加沙南部这些地点寻求援助的巴勒斯坦人群屡遭炮火袭击的事件不断发生。

sentences.en: At least eight people have been killed in the last 24 hours and 74 injured.
sentences.zh: 在过去 24 小时内，至少有 8 人丧生，74 人受伤。

sentences.en: Including as recently as this week.
sentences.zh: 包括就在本周发生的事件。

sentences.en: 32 people are confirmed dead after they tried to reach an aid site in southern Gaza.
sentences.zh: 经证实，有 32 人在试图抵达加沙南部的一个援助点时身亡。

sentences.en: This is according to Gazan hospital officials.
sentences.zh: 这是根据加沙医院官员提供的消息。

sentences.en: Israeli troops say they've had to control rowdy crowds trying to get to these sites.
sentences.zh: 以军表示，他们不得不控制试图前往这些地点的骚乱人群。

sentences.en: The foundation says there's been no violence in or near the sites themselves.
sentences.zh: 该基金会表示，这些地点内部或附近没有发生过暴力事件。

sentences.en: Aaron, you mentioned that the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation only has four aid distribution sites set up,
sentences.zh: 亚伦，你提到加沙人道主义基金会只设立了四个援助分发点，

sentences.en: and that's compared with 400 sites that were in place before this new system took over.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，在这个新系统接管之前，有 400 个分发点。

sentences.en: I think that everybody can understand why crowded situations can be more dangerous generally, but especially in a place like Gaza.
sentences.zh: 我想每个人都能理解为什么拥挤的情况通常会更危险，在加沙这样的地方尤其如此。

sentences.en: But in these situations that we've been talking about, people are actually getting shot near these aid sites, right?
sentences.zh: 但在我们一直在讨论的这些情况下，人们实际上是在这些援助点附近遭到枪击，对吧？

sentences.en: So it feels like there's probably something else going on besides simply that these sites are incredibly crowded.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉除了这些地方极其拥挤之外，可能还有其他事情正在发生。

sentences.en: You're absolutely right to point to crowding as an issue.
sentences.zh: 你指出拥挤是一个问题是完全正确的。

sentences.en: But really, I think the fundamental problem goes back to what the original critics from the United Nations and from the aid community said at the beginning,
sentences.zh: 但实际上，我认为根本问题可以追溯到联合国和人道主义社群的最初批评者在起初时所说的话，

sentences.en: which is that thousands of people are crossing Israeli military lines in a war zone.
sentences.zh: 那就是成千上万的人正在战区穿越以色列的军事防线。

sentences.en: And they're going to aid sites, which, unlike in the past, are now surrounded by Israeli soldiers.
sentences.zh: 他们前往援助点，与过去不同的是，这些援助点现在被以色列士兵所包围。

sentences.en: That is the deadly combination that we've seen.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所看到的致命组合。

sentences.en: Now, it's important to point out, the United Nations and other aid organizations are still bringing some aid into Gaza.
sentences.zh: 现在，有一点很重要，需要指出的是，联合国和其他人道主义组织仍在向加沙运送一些援助物资。

sentences.en: And there have also been some shootings linked to their distribution.
sentences.zh: 并且也发生了一些与他们的分发活动有关的枪击事件。

sentences.en: But the majority of the deaths reported by Gaza officials took place in the vicinity of the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation sites.
sentences.zh: 但加沙官员报告的大多数死亡事件都发生在加沙人道主义基金会站点的附近。

sentences.en: Obviously, live ammunition is not an accepted form of crowd control.
sentences.zh: 很明显，实弹射击不是一种被接受的控场形式。

sentences.en: Has Israel explained why this has happened over and over again?
sentences.zh: 以色列是否解释过为什么这种情况会一再发生？

sentences.en: At times, they've said that Israeli soldiers fired warning shots at people who approached them and who posed a kind of threat.
sentences.zh: 有时他们曾表示，以色列士兵向接近他们并构成某种威胁的人员发射了警告射击。

sentences.en: But they've also basically disputed the casualty tolls that come out of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 但他们基本上也对加沙公布的伤亡人数提出了异议。

sentences.en: They say that casualties that are released by the Gaza Health Ministry, which is a branch of the Hamas-run administration in the Gaza Strip, are not reliable.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，由加沙卫生部（哈马斯在加沙地带管理的行政机构的一个分支）发布的伤亡人数并不可靠。

sentences.en: And at times, they've accused people that have echoed these reports of mass casualties of distorting reality.
sentences.zh: 而且有时，他们指责那些呼应这些重大伤亡报告的人在歪曲现实。

sentences.en: So it basically sounds like Israel is denying that this is a huge issue.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上听起来以色列是在否认这是一个重大问题。

sentences.en: So the Israeli military says that they've learned lessons, that they're working on renovating some of the sites,
sentences.zh: 因此，以色列军方表示他们已经吸取了教训，他们正在努力改造一些地点，

sentences.en: that they're trying to ensure that whatever incidents there have been don't recur.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图确保无论发生过什么事件都不会再次发生。

sentences.en: But just last weekend, we saw two deadly incidents, one related to the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation, another related to the World Food Program convoy,
sentences.zh: 但就在上周末，我们看到了两起致命事件，一起与加沙人道主义基金会有关，另一起与世界粮食计划署的车队有关，

sentences.en: where Israeli soldiers reportedly opened fire, killing and wounding dozens of people.
sentences.zh: 据报道，以色列士兵在这些事件中开枪，造成数十人死伤。

sentences.en: And so unfortunately, we've seen these deadly shootings are continuing.
sentences.zh: 因此不幸的是，我们看到这种致命的枪击事件仍在继续。

sentences.en: The Gaza Humanitarian Foundation has also rejected a lot of these reports.
sentences.zh: 加沙人道主义基金会也驳斥了许多此类报道。

sentences.en: But at the same time, they've said that mostly they're speaking about what happens at their sites or immediately around their sites.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他们表示，他们主要讨论的是其站点内或其站点周围紧邻区域发生的事情。

sentences.en: So they're not really commenting as much on what happens to people on the way to the site, which is when, you know, at least in our reporting, when a lot of the deadly shootings,
sentences.zh: 因此，他们实际上并没有对人们在前往该地点途中发生的事情发表太多评论，而在我们的报道中，恰恰是在那个时候，许多致命的枪击事件

sentences.en: unfortunately, have taken place.
sentences.zh: 不幸地发生了。

sentences.en: And what about the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么美国在这当中又扮演了什么角色？

sentences.en: in all of this?
sentences.zh: 在这整件事中呢？

sentences.en: Has the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国方面有没有发表什么言论？

sentences.en: said anything?
sentences.zh: 因为正如你所提到的，美国

sentences.en: Because as you mentioned, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 至少为这项工作提供了部分资金。

sentences.en: is providing at least a chunk of funding to this effort.
sentences.zh: 所以，美国

sentences.en: So the U.S.
sentences.zh: 已经成为加沙人道主义基金会的坚定捍卫者。

sentences.en: has emerged as a staunch defender of the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation.
sentences.zh: 在前执行董事杰克·伍德离开该倡议后，他们迎来了新负责人，一位名叫约翰尼·穆尔（Johnny Moore）的福音派领袖，

sentences.en: After Jake Wood, the former executive director, left the initiative, they brought in a new head, an evangelical leader named Johnny Moore,
sentences.zh: 他被视为与特朗普总统相当亲近。

sentences.en: who's seen as quite close to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 事实上，来自国务院的 3000 万美元资金，实际上是在这些枪击事件的报道开始出现几周后才得到批准的。

sentences.en: And in fact, the $30 million in funding from the State Department was actually authorized weeks after these reports of shootings began to emerge.
sentences.zh: 因此，这当然让人觉得是对新系统真正的信任投票，尽管特朗普政府实际上正在削减政府其他地方的对外援助。

sentences.en: So that certainly feels like a real vote of confidence in the new system, even as the Trump administration was actually cutting foreign aid elsewhere in the government.
sentences.zh: 显然，这场战争招致了国际社会的谴责，我很好奇我们是否听到国际社会对这一特定努力做出的回应。

sentences.en: Obviously, this war has invited international condemnation, and I'm curious whether we have heard from the international community in response to this effort specifically.
sentences.zh: 是的，它受到了许多人的谴责，包括以色列自己的盟友，你知道的，那些

sentences.en: So it's been condemned by many, including Israel's own allies, you know, countries that are
sentences.zh: 历史上支持以色列的国家，如英国、法国和德国，都对加沙人道主义基金会表示了极大的怀疑。

sentences.en: historically supportive of Israel, like the United Kingdom and Germany and France, have expressed a lot of skepticism about the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation.
sentences.zh: 英国、法国和德国等历史上的以色列盟友，对加沙人道主义基金会表示了极大的怀疑。

sentences.en: And just earlier this week, a coalition of around 30 countries issued a joint statement where they really condemned this new
sentences.zh: 就在本周早些时候，一个由大约30个国家组成的联盟发表了一份联合声明，强烈谴责了这个新

sentences.en: system, which they said deprived Gazans of their human dignity.
sentences.zh: 系统，他们称该系统剥夺了加沙人的尊严。

sentences.en: Have any of those condemnations moved the needle at all, just in terms of Israel acknowledging any kind of problem or conceding that this aid distribution system
sentences.zh: 这些谴责有没有起到哪怕一点点作用呢？比如让以色列承认存在某种问题，或者承认这个物资分发系统

sentences.en: had issues that perhaps it didn't earlier recognize?
sentences.zh: 存在之前没有意识到的问题？

sentences.en: So publicly, at least, Israeli officials have defended the initiative.
sentences.zh: 所以至少在公开场合，以色列官员一直在为这项倡议辩护。

sentences.en: But there's also reason to believe that they're not totally thrilled with how it's turned out.
sentences.zh: 但也有理由相信，他们对最终的结果并不是完全满意。

sentences.en: After all, Israel promised that this was going to be an orderly system, not just for the sake of Gazans, but also because the whole reason behind this overhaul
sentences.zh: 毕竟，以色列曾承诺这将是一个秩序井然的系统，不仅是为了加沙人，也是因为这次大调整的整个初衷

sentences.en: was to prevent the aid from going to Hamas or benefiting Hamas.
sentences.zh: 就是为了防止援助物资落入哈马斯手中或让哈马斯受益。

sentences.en: But the rollout has been so messy and so disorganized that it doesn't really seem like anyone is checking who's coming to pick up these boxes of aid.
sentences.zh: 但推行过程如此混乱、毫无条理，以至于看起来根本没人去核实到底是谁来领取这些援助物资。

sentences.en: So some officials and analysts have suggested that even by the Israelis own standards.
sentences.zh: 因此，一些官员和分析人士指出，即使按照以色列自己的标准来衡量，

sentences.en: It's not clear whether they've been so successful.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚他们究竟取得了多大的成功。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, this is all really symptomatic of a much bigger problem with Israel's whole approach to Gaza.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，这一切其实都折射出以色列对待加沙的整体方针存在着一个更大的问题。

sentences.en: How do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: All these scenes of desperation and chaos, they all really underscore that right now, nobody is really responsible for governing in Gaza, for providing for the welfare of Gazans,
sentences.zh: 所有这些绝望和混乱的场景，都真切地突显出，目前在加沙，没有人真正负责管理治理，没有人真正负责保障加沙人的福祉，

sentences.en: and for instituting law and order.
sentences.zh: 也没有人负责维持法律和秩序。

sentences.en: The Israeli military has decimated the Hamas government, which used to run Gaza, and it hasn't allowed anything to come up in its place.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方已经摧毁了曾经管理加沙的哈马斯政府，却没有允许任何替代势力取而代之。

sentences.en: So the result has been anarchy.
sentences.zh: 因此，结果就是无政府状态。

sentences.en: Now, this might be the result of bad planning,
sentences.zh: 现在，这可能是计划不周导致的，

sentences.en: but there are also critics of Israel who have argued that for Israel, the chaos in Gaza could also be part of a larger strategy, either to further weaken Hamas
sentences.zh: 但以色列的一些批评者认为，对以色列而言，加沙的混乱可能也是其更大战略的一部分，要么是为了进一步削弱哈马斯，

sentences.en: or just to make the situation in Gaza so unlivable that Palestinians might volunteer to leave on their own.
sentences.zh: 要么就是让加沙的局势变得如此不宜居，以至于巴勒斯坦人可能会选择自愿离开。

sentences.en: So we're now nearly two years into this war.
sentences.zh: 所以这场战争现在已经持续了近两年。

sentences.en: We're at almost 60,000 Palestinians killed, according to Gaza health officials.
sentences.zh: 根据加沙卫生官员的数据，已有近6万名巴勒斯坦人丧生。

sentences.en: There's rising malnutrition.
sentences.zh: 营养不良问题日益严重。

sentences.en: The Israeli military now controls much of the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 以色列军队现在控制了加沙地带的大部分地区。

sentences.en: And ordinary Gazans are still just trying to survive from one day to the next.
sentences.zh: 而普通的加沙人仍然在苦苦挣扎，勉强度日。

sentences.en: Aaron, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 亚伦，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, more than 100 aid agencies and human rights groups, including Save the Children and Doctors Without Borders, warned that, quote,
sentences.zh: 周三，包括“救助儿童会”和“无国界医生”在内的100多个援助机构和人权组织发出警告称，引述：

sentences.en: mass starvation was spreading across Gaza.
sentences.zh: 大规模饥荒正在加沙蔓延。

sentences.en: The joint statement adds to growing calls for Israel to lift restrictions on humanitarian aid and for the war to end.
sentences.zh: 这份联合声明进一步呼吁以色列解除对人道主义援助的限制并结束战争。

sentences.en: Israel's foreign ministry rejected the group's claims, saying that the organizations were echoing Hamas talking points.
sentences.zh: 以色列外交部拒绝了这些组织的说法，称这些机构在重复哈马斯的谈资。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Columbia University has agreed to pay a $200 million fine to settle allegations from the Trump administration that it failed to do enough to stop the harassment of Jewish students.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚大学已同意支付2亿美元罚款，以就特朗普政府指控其未能采取足够措施制止针对犹太学生的骚扰达成和解。

sentences.en: The settlement is part of a sweeping deal to restore the university's federal research funding, which the White House had canceled.
sentences.zh: 这项和解是恢复该大学联邦研究经费的一揽子协议的一部分，此前白宫曾取消过这些经费。

sentences.en: Columbia had been the earliest target of the Trump administration's efforts to overhaul the country's most elite academic institutions.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚大学一直是特朗普政府试图彻底改造美国最精英学术机构的早期目标。

sentences.en: As part of the settlement, the university also agreed to a number of different terms,
sentences.zh: 作为和解协议的一部分，该大学还同意了一系列不同的条款，

sentences.en: including the appointment of a provost to oversee Middle Eastern studies and the appointment of three dozen public safety officers with arrest powers.
sentences.zh: 包括任命一名教务长来监督中东研究，以及任命数十名拥有逮捕权的公共安全官员。

sentences.en: And, on Wednesday, a judge sentenced Brian Koberger, who was convicted of killing four Idaho college students in 2022, to life in prison with no chance of parole.
sentences.zh: 另外，在周三，一名法官判处因2022年杀害四名爱达荷州大学生而被定罪的布赖恩·科伯格终身监禁，不得假释。

sentences.en: Friends and family members of the victims spoke of their loss, with one telling the killer to, quote, go to hell.
sentences.zh: 受害者的朋友和家属讲述了他们失去亲人的痛苦，其中一人对凶手说，引述：下地狱吧。

sentences.en: Others demanded to know why he had committed his crimes.
sentences.zh: 其他人则质问他为什么要犯下这些罪行。

sentences.en: Mr. Koberger declined to speak or explain his motives.
sentences.zh: 科伯格先生拒绝发言或解释他的动机。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由克莱尔·坦尼斯-凯特尔、

sentences.en: Rochelle Bonja, and Mooch Zadie.
sentences.zh: 罗谢尔·邦贾和穆奇·扎迪制作。

sentences.zh: 由玛丽亚·伯恩剪辑，佩奇·考维特和本·卡尔霍恩提供了协助。

sentences.en: Fact-checked by Susan Lee, contains original music by Dan Powell and Pat McCusker, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·李进行事实核查，包含丹·鲍威尔和帕特·麦卡斯克的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德担任音频工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel AbraMs.
sentences.zh: 我是雷切尔·艾布拉姆斯。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party, operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了大批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党陷入了一场激烈、混乱有时又惊心动魄的权力争斗中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在途中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
